tool.name: DeepSeek-V3
tool.summary: DeepSeek's flagship 671B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), activating 37B params per token with industry-leading efficiency.
tool.architecture: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) + DeepSeekMoE + FP8 Mixed Precision Training.
tool.usage:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="YOUR_KEY", base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
  model="deepseek-chat",
  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain MLA architecture."}]
)
tool.limitations: Massive parameter footprint requires multi-GPU or cloud API hosting.
